The four address clauses quoted from the named source are transcribed into the contract as four increment tables, the checker builds the head number out of those tables and derives their place weights as successive differences, and the map it built agrees with the coordinate formula of the earlier notes on all eighty-one heads, so the transcription's arithmetic generates that formula: the check is of the transcription and not of any edition, and it would succeed for any transcription carrying those increments. The nine heads with the last two places at their first value are heads one, ten, nineteen, twenty-eight, thirty-seven, forty-six, fifty-five, sixty-four and seventy-three, equally spaced by nine, exactly the fiber over two fixed places and defined by exactly two place constraints with the other two places free. Of the eighty moduli from two to eighty-one, only eighty-one makes the prefix a union of complete residue classes, which is trivial, and the other seventy-nine each fail with a witness pair; the small case outnumbers the classes and the large case has pairwise incongruent tail elements. One displacement, one two one one, carries head seven to head forty-seven and head eight to head forty-eight, has order three, gives the orbits seven forty-seven sixty-nine and eight forty-eight sixty-seven, and splits all eighty-one heads into twenty-seven three-cycles. The river diagram's pairs are exactly the fibers of reduction modulo five on one to nine, every pair differs by five, the shift on the ten residues is fixed-point free, exactly one number loses its partner when restricted to one to nine, and the label is a function of the residue class. The calendar gives three hundred sixty-four and a half days for the cycle and three hundred sixty-five and a half for the year, boundaries at multiples of four and a half days, and a split into four hundred twenty-three and three hundred six praises. Every one of the twenty-four nodes lies within nine quarters of a day of a boundary by construction, its distance being computed exactly as the minimum over all eighty-one head boundaries; the reported node's distance to its nearest boundary is forty-one twenty-fourths of a day, worse than the median, ranking fourteenth of twenty-three and not the closest node, and another node is more than seventy-six times closer. RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_FSIZE and the wall alarm are installed and no address-space ceiling is installed because no child process is launched.

The two rewrite routes for A*(B+C)^-1, namely (A1+A2) against one inverse and A1, A2 against two inverses, are equal exactly by cross multiplication and equal at every one of five declared sample points by exact rational equality. Core plus shell equals the whole expression at every declared budget; under a budget of one step the second denominator term is frozen as a shell carrying its unexpanded tree, its exact denotation and its reason, and the verdict is UnknownWithRetainedShell rather than a rounded value. One shared truncation on both routes preserves the identity, which refutes the reading that truncation by itself tears distributivity. Per-branch truncation at different points breaks it exactly on the members whose outer terms differ and not on the member whose outer terms are equal, and the difference is verified as an identity rather than asserted: branch_left - branch_right = (A1 - A2)*(T1 - T2), with the retained exact differences 11/18*x - 1/3 and 32/225*x^3 - 62/225*x^2 - 34/225*x + 4/15. What truncation breaks is identifiability: the carried shell no longer equals the exact residual, the dropped term is verified non-zero, and the leak is exactly the residual times the outer factor. The pair decides value and not structure: the routes agree in value while their literal representatives differ, so a reduction rule would be required for object equality. Zero denominator, inversion of zero, and a forged shell whose tree misses its denotation are each refused. The float aperture scanner classifies this checker exact-only, with zero binary64, host and drift constructs. 351 assertions, 0.03 seconds, reproduced byte for byte on a fresh run.

checker_profile.declared_evidence: docs/research/0202-does-a-step-close-more-than-it-opens.md records the run; experiments/aperture_ledger/evidence.json retains it. In the scanner currency the line closes more than it opens: the exact-only count rose from five to thirteen while the deciding count rose by one, so the strict net over the line is seven, and exactly one step opened more than it closed, namely the round that put two float probes on an acceptance path on purpose. Because an illustration-only experiment is still an aperture that decides nothing, the run reports a strict net and a loose net of seven and three and names the four steps where they disagree, so how much an opening is worth is itself a declaration. In the mass currency a resolving step closes a layer and opens nothing while a truncating step opens a residual inside the cut ideal whose mass is of the same order as the layer it closes, giving a net of zero, and two levels change nothing at all because no accepted cylinder has those lengths. In the statement currency the net is exactly zero, because each correction appended to a note closes a statement while the sentence a later recomputation refuted stays in the frozen evidence by design, so that currency has a structural floor that correcting notes cannot pass. The instrument also turned out to be inside what it measures: this round is itself an experiment in the inventory it counts and was classed exact-only, so the series includes it and its last point is a fixed point rather than a reading, while a round whose own verdict were deciding would open a count by measuring it. Four slips remain on the record: the sign convention was first read backwards and no check or test caught it because both readings gave non-empty lists, the currency first counted two verdicts instead of four and produced steps with no net change, and the retained inventory records the exact-only steps as numeric deltas while the deciding step appears only in prose, so part of the series is a reconstruction and the run says which part, and the round was first left out of its own series, which made the evidence contradict the inventory until it was counted.

The traversal walks a real sha256 anchor chain and joins levels one through three under the doubling cost, refusing from level four, which agrees with the critical level computed independently from the reserve; every failed join leaves the chain head and the resolved level unchanged, so the rollback is free exactly while the reserve belongs to no side, and carving it out of a side costs that side the failed join's two steps out of thirty-three. checker_profile.declared_evidence: docs/research/0172-the-i-minus-e-integrality-conjecture.md records the analysis; experiments/integer_power_absurdity/evidence.json retains the result. With z = i - e, Re z = -e < 0, Im z = 1, |z|^2 = 1 + e^2 exactly and arg z = pi - atan(1/e), so z Log z = (-eA - B) + i(A - eB) and the principal modulus is exp(-eA - B). Both terms of Re(z Log z) are negative, since A = ln(1+e^2)/2 > 0 and B > pi/2 > 0, so the modulus is strictly between 0 and 1 and no integer is attained; the run sharpens this to below 1/10 via A > ln 2 and B > 3/2, giving exp(-(2 ln 2 + 3/2)) = e^(-3/2)/4 < (2/5)/4. The measured principal modulus is 0.003413988192252096... with a 43-digit enclosure width. On branch k the modulus is exp(-eA - B - 2 pi k): for k >= 0 it is at most the principal modulus and every such branch is refuted outright; for k < 0 it grows, and the enclosure, made tight by argument halving and squaring, is narrower than one unit at its own magnitude and contains no integer, so those branches are refuted too. The near misses are retained as distances: at k = -2 the modulus is 978.965597, thirty-four thousandths short of 979, and at k = -6 it is 80496734139626.61 against 80496734139627. The phase condition on each branch is also evaluated and no branch in the range has a multiple of pi inside its phase enclosure. Internal consistency checks confirm that exponentiating A returns 1 + e^2 and that the sine and cosine enclosures satisfy the Pythagorean identity, and the enclosures of e, pi and ln 2 agree with the published digits at the published precision. 879 assertions, 0.4 seconds, reproduced byte for byte on a fresh run.

The cosine of the angle between two faces is computed exactly as 1/3. The composite of the reflections in two distinct faces is computed as a rational affine map, verified orthogonal with determinant one, with trace exactly -5/9, so 2 cos of its angle is -14/9. A finite-order rotation has trace one plus a sum of two roots of unity, which is an algebraic integer; -14/9 is rational in lowest terms with denominator 9, and the criterion that a rational is an algebraic integer exactly when its denominator in lowest terms is one is verified on nine declared rationals; so the rotation has infinite order, the generated group is infinite, and the orbit of the vertex (1,1,1), which is verified not to lie on the shared edge of the two faces, is infinite. In the same way 2 cos of the dihedral angle is 2/3, also not an algebraic integer, so the angle is not a rational multiple of pi, which is the reason the layers cannot close. The enumeration is an illustration only: the new points at layers one to six are 1, 3, 9, 27, 81, 243 with every point from layer two on having exactly three forward images against one return, giving exact ternary growth within the declared depth and not beyond it. The finite contrast is run through the same pipeline: reflections in the three coordinate planes generate a group of order eight and the composite has trace -1 with 2 cos equal to -2, an algebraic integer, so the criterion does not call a finite group infinite. 107 assertions, 0.04 seconds, reproduced byte for byte on a fresh run.
